data.title: Gorgeous-GRUB: collection of decent community-made GRUB themes
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一个收集优秀社区制作的GRUB引导加载程序主题的项目。由于这些主题分散在不同网站，难以找到高质量的，作者整理了这个项目以集中展示一些精心制作的主题，包括自定义背景、字体和颜色。用户可以轻松自定义这些主题，如更换背景、调整元素位置或修改颜色方案。项目提供了有用的链接和安装指南，并鼓励用户为喜爱的主题评分或点赞。项目还列出了大量具体主题示例和贡献指南。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕GRUB bootloader的优缺点及其定制化的讨论

不同观点：
• 支持GRUB定制化：有些用户（如WD-42和tmountain）欣赏GRUB的创意和美学定制潜力，认为这些定制让Linux更有趣，尤其是在双启动场景下。
• 对GRUB的不满：部分用户（如userbinator和buserror）认为GRUB过于复杂且不必要，尤其是它的配置和代码难以理解，且存在性能问题。他们更倾向于使用更轻量级的替代方案。
• 对GRUB实用性的肯定：ykonstant承认GRUB的问题，但指出其在多种硬件环境下的强大兼容性和功能性，认为其复杂性可能源于项目的广泛范围。

补充讨论：
• GRUB的多媒体功能：marcodiego提出希望GRUB能模仿旧SGI启动的多媒体体验，包括启动音频和微型系统设置。
• GRUB的用户体验问题：PebblesHD希望GRUB在无操作时保持静默，避免不必要的等待时间。
• GRUB的显示问题：imcritic关注GRUB在不同显示器上的分辨率适应问题，noisy_boy则提到其在多显示器设置下的不便。
• GRUB的安全性和漏洞：1vuio0pswjnm7提到了GRUB认证漏洞（CVE-2015-8370），强调其潜在安全风险。
• 特定使用案例：christina97在处理Ubuntu升级时遇到与GRUB和加密ZFS相关的bug，提醒用户谨慎使用ZFS。

争议焦点：
• GRUB的必要性与复杂性：支持者欣赏其功能和兼容性，反对者则认为其过于复杂且难以维护，主张使用更轻量级的替代方案。
• GRUB的用户体验：部分用户认为GRUB的默认配置不够友好，尤其是在无操作时的等待时间和多显示器设置下的表现。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 定制GRUB的主题和外观：如Grosvenor提到希望通过定制使计算机看起来像电影中的黑客设备，以及用户分享的具体定制实例（如Jacksaur的Gorgeous-GRUB主题）。
• 配置过程中遇到的技术问题：如pndy提到在Manjaro中更新覆盖了自定义主题，以及访问GitHub时遇到的速率限制问题。

🚀 Intro
There are many great community made GRUB themes to spice up your bootloader before booting into your system proper. Unfortunately, they're spread across multiple sites and it can be difficult to find good ones. As another user told me, the majority of themes on Pling (the largest host of GRUB themes currently) are fairly low effort and can be boring to trawl through. Hence, I decided to put together this page to bring attention to some decent themes I've found around the internet over time. They aren't all absolute masterpieces of course: But they've all at least had a fair amount of effort put into them, with custom backgrounds, fonts, and colours.
And don't forget,
themes are extremely easy to customize!
Like a theme's layout but prefer a different background? Just replace the image in its folder with one of your own. Don't like the positioning of a theme's elements? Open the theme.txt and change their values. Want a different colour scheme? They're all set by HEX Values, which you can swap out in seconds. You can even convert almost any font to the type GRUB uses with the grub-mkfont command, then change the
item_font
line in the theme.txt to use it.
There's loads of potential for customization, you just have to work creatively around the limitations.
🌟 Useful Links
GitZip
- Download individual folders and files from Github repositories without having to download the entire repo. Asks for a Token, but seems to work without just fine.
GRUB-Tweaks
- Multiple guides on various tweaks and additions you can make to further customize, or repair, your GRUB install.
Theme Tutorial
and
Theme References
- Pretty complex, but the best set of information I've managed to find so far. It may be easier to start by taking an existing theme and making edits to it yourself, rather than diving straight in and starting from scratch.
Background Cycler
- Script I made that will cycle a theme to a different background each time your system is rebooted. The Cron job can be modified to run at specific amounts of time instead if desired.

If you like a theme, please do consider giving it a rating on Pling or starring its repo on Github. It's very rare for anyone to rate on Pling and that's half the reason good themes are so hard to find. Plus, it always feels nice to see that people are enjoying the product you created.

data.title: Why I Am Not Going to Buy a Computer (1987) [pdf]
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于计算机的使用与影响的讨论，包括历史视角、个人体验、技术哲学以及对新技术的态度。

不同观点：
• analog31分享了个人经历，提到在1987年时大学计算机店的建议：“电脑不会帮你整理，如果你桌面乱，电脑里也会乱。”他表示至今仍然遇到这种问题，反映出技术无法完全解决个人习惯问题。

• YeGoblynQueenne指出，如今大多数人并不真正拥有或使用传统意义上的电脑，而是依赖手机进行有限的操作。他认为这与80年代技术先锋的预期形成讽刺对比，并提到自己拥有多台电脑设备，显示出对技术的持续兴趣。

• dredmorbius引用了Wendell Berry的文章，展示了对不购买电脑的坚持，反映了一种对技术消费主义的批判态度。

• Jtsummers提供了过去讨论的链接，显示出这一话题在不同时间点的讨论热度。

• waynenilsen提供了相关文章链接，引导读者思考类似的深层次问题。

• ViktorRay赞赏了一本杂志上关于某篇文章的回应，认为过去的严厉评论与现代互联网评论有相似之处，提醒人们这种现象一直存在。

• reilly3000讨论了不同写作媒介对内容和思维的影响，认为高成本的写作方式促使更精确的表达，并提出手写可能赋予作品某种独特的精神。

• Jordan_Pelt对某篇文章中的一句话提出批评，认为其削弱了整篇文章的意义。

• erehweb提到不同出版物对投稿方式的要求，反映出计算机在出版行业中增加的便利性。

• tankenmate评论了某篇文章的创新性，认为不使用电脑的想法并非新颖，并提到Luddites的历史。

• milliams对某篇文章中的建议表示困惑，特别是关于使用太阳能的建议。

• jes5199提到对作者的其他认识，指出其在碳捕获领域的受欢迎程度，这影响了他对文章的看法。

• stodor89对文章及其中的观点表示赞赏，并对关于作者妻子的评论感到有趣，认为有些过于干涉和自以为是。

• roschdal总结了新技术采用的合理理由清单，强调了经济性、可修复性、本地购买和不破坏已有良好关系等方面。

• gizajob以讽刺的语气询问在哪里可以找到帮忙打字和语法检查的“妻子”，反映了性别角色和技术辅助的陈旧观念。

补充讨论：
• 评论中涉及了对技术作用的反思，包括电脑是否能提升个人效率、新技术对社会和人际关系的影响，以及不同媒介对写作和思维的影响。
• 对某篇文章及其观点的批评与支持，展示了不同读者对技术态度的分歧。
• 对历史背景的提及，如80年代的计算机使用建议和Luddites的历史，提供了更广泛的视角来理解当前的讨论。

data.title: Legendary Bose Magic Carpet Suspension Is Finally Going Global
data.author: PaulHoule
data.article_summary: 二十多年前，Bose公司开发的电磁主动悬挂系统在一辆雷克萨斯LS400上展示了惊人的性能，包括跨过路肩、避让坑洞和完全平稳地过弯。然而，该技术在2004年因不适用于大规模生产而被放弃。尽管如此，相关视频时不时在网上走红。如今，这项技术由美国公司ClearMotion进一步开发，并首次应用于中国电动车蔚来ET9上，未来还将扩展到300万辆汽车。ClearMotion还与保时捷达成合作，开发能"指纹"路面的主动底盘控制软件。这项曾经看似魔法的悬挂技术终于走向现实。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：ClearMotion公司开发的主动悬挂系统及其技术创新与市场应用

不同观点：
• **ClearMotion创始人[zacka]**：ClearMotion1系统是市场的重大飞跃，震动传输减少约80%。该系统使用电液执行器、预测控制软件和 crowdsourced 道路数据，旨在解决自主车辆中的晕车问题，并提升整体驾乘体验。创始人也提到他们的系统经过了长达5年的测试，并被NIO和保时捷等客户采用。

• **[genter]**：认为ClearMotion的技术并非全新，其他汽车制造商如凯迪拉克、福特、奔驰等早已在使用类似的主动悬挂技术。不同厂商的实现方式各异，但核心概念都是通过计算机调节减震器。此外，提到Bose此前的技术由于耗电过大而不实用。

• **[thih9]**：提到Bose此前开发的主动噪音消除和座椅技术，并将ClearMotion的技术比喻为车轮的主动噪音消除。同时提到Bose的技术在市场上仍属小众。

• **[Animats]**：提到BYD的Yangwang U9超级跑车已经使用类似的主动悬挂技术两年，且功能更加夸张，如感知坑洞、单轮行驶等。

• **[HPsquared]**：提到奔驰的主动车身控制系统（Active Body Control），使用液压缸和常规悬挂弹簧组合，能够处理高达5Hz的频率，改善行驶和操控性能。

• **[mike-the-mikado]**：提出如果主动悬挂技术普及，未来减速带的存在意义将受到质疑，并讨论了减速带对不同车辆的效果。

• **[neom]**：认为ClearMotion的技术可能预示未来L4级别自动驾驶车辆的发展方向，并提到其在减少停车距离方面的潜力。

• **[nabla9]**：指出Citroen在1954年就开始引领主动悬挂技术，奔驰、宝马等品牌随后跟进，认为Bose进入该领域较晚且在“重新发明轮子”。

• **[kfarr]**：希望这种技术能应用于公交车，特别是电车，以提升乘坐舒适性。

• **[fallinditch]**：询问当今与过去的豪华车（如Lexus LS400）的等价车型。

• **[svilen_dobrev]**：对这种技术的实际落地持怀疑态度，类似于“飞行汽车”和“核聚变”技术，长期未能实现，并担心如果这种技术普及，道路可能会加速恶化。

• **[dataviz1000]**：提到Dan Ackroyd曾为类似的项目代言，暗示这种技术早已有之。

• **[SoftTalker]**：担心这种复杂技术会增加车辆故障率，呼吁制造更简单实惠的汽车。

• **[franktankbank]**：对技术的可靠性和故障模式表示关注。

补充讨论：
- ClearMotion的主动悬挂技术在市场上是否真正具有创新性存在争议。
- 对主动悬挂技术在不同车型（如公交车、超级跑车、自动驾驶车辆）上的潜在应用进行了讨论。
- 对技术普及后可能带来的社会影响（如道路维护）提出了担忧。

Over twenty years ago,
a video of a Lexus LS400
seemingly defying the laws of physics shocked the world. Riding on a prototype electromechanical proactive suspension developed by the audio company Bose, the luxury sedan bunny-hopped over curbs, skipped individual wheels over potholes, cornered completely flat, and held its body perfectly level at speed over undulating pavement. It looked like magic, and to some degree it was.
Sadly
it was totally impractical for mass production in 2004
, and Bose eventually gave up on the project and sold off the rights to the tech. Meanwhile, the demo clips lodged themselves in the internet as a prime example of amazing technology that didn’t make it. Every few years,
the videos go viral again
as a new round of people ask why we can’t get something this cool in new cars today.
And at last, now you can. OK, almost.
Last month, the proactive suspension—which is now owned and further developed by an American company called ClearMotion—finally hit the streets in China in its first use in a production car, the electric Nio ET9. It’s just the start of a deal with Nio that will put the suspension in 3 million cars. As
Automotive News
points out, that kind of scale could really help bring down costs as ClearMotion is getting ready to enter a partnership with Porsche and holding talks with other European automakers. You can see just how impressive it is in the video below.
In other words, Bose’s suspension is finally having the global moment we’ve been waiting for. And we have been waiting! In 2018 (I cannot believe that was seven years ago),
we wrote a story about ClearMotion
installing its suspension in a BMW 5 Series and its CEO working on deals with “five major manufacturers” that would bring the tech to mass production in 2020. To be fair, we know what happened there.
Also to be fair, this isn’t exactly Bose’s suspension. The original version replaced traditional dampers with linear electric motors that used sensor data to literally move the wheels up and down and cancel out bumps. ClearMotion adapted the control software and applied to active valve dampers with a magnetic fluid.
Still, you have to step back and appreciate that this technology is finally stepping out of a 240p YouTube video and into reality in new cars. Speaking of, we also recently wrote a story about someone
finding one of the original Lexus LS400 Bose prototypes
for sale as a parts car on Facebook Marketplace. It’s a good read, I promise.
Now that the Bose/ClearMotion magic carpet suspension has moved beyond its conceptual testing phase, there’s no stopping the tech from being applied to anything and everything.
CYVN Holdings
, the investment firm keeping
McLaren
afloat, is also an investor in Nio. A trickle-up effect is undoubtedly imminent.
In the Porsche deal, the German automaker will utilize ClearMotion1 but also launch RoadMotion, a proactive chassis control software that “fingerprints” road surfaces. The software stores the scanned information to create a localized street profile, which the system will auto-adapt to when driving through the area again.

43843241.article_summary: 二十多年前，Bose公司开发的电磁主动悬挂系统在一辆雷克萨斯LS400上展示了惊人的性能，包括跨过路肩、避让坑洞和完全平稳地过弯。然而，该技术在2004年因不适用于大规模生产而被放弃。尽管如此，相关视频时不时在网上走红。如今，这项技术由美国公司ClearMotion进一步开发，并首次应用于中国电动车蔚来ET9上，未来还将扩展到300万辆汽车。ClearMotion还与保时捷达成合作，开发能"指纹"路面的主动底盘控制软件。这项曾经看似魔法的悬挂技术终于走向现实。

data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 《Understanding J》是一份简明介绍J编程语言的文档，适合有一定编程经验的读者。J语言源自APL，采用ASCII字符，支持多维数组操作，基本内建函数常为单个符号或附加点、冒号的符号。J中的数据值称为“名词”，包括数字、列表、字符串等，字符串使用单引号且通过双写引号来转义。J还支持一些特殊数据类型，如符号和稀疏数组。文档建议运行示例代码以加深理解，并提供了J语言的在线资源和快速入门指南。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕编程语言J的评价与使用体验，以及对J语言某些特性的疑问和建议

不同观点：
• [vintagedave] 认为J语言在学习过程中非常令人困惑，课程中的编译器/环境存在许多bug，但随着使用更多编程语言，他对J产生了更多兴趣，并希望深入学习。

• [gitroom] 表示J语言中下划线的用法让人困惑，虽然不习惯，但尊重其独特的设计选择。

Understanding J
An introduction to the J programming language that gets to the point.
It is intended for those with (some) programming experience, but others
should be mostly fine after looking up some basic programming terms like
function, argument, class, instance, inheritance, statement, expression,
etc.
Don't treat this as a reference: Section titles do not introduce an
exhaustive explanation of a certain topic, but serve to give this
document a rough structure. Individual sections are not intended to be
read in isolation from the others and assume the knowledge of previous
sections.
Run the examples and read the comments!
If you have J installed you can open this file in JQt via the
file-selection dialog which opens with
ctrl+o
(make sure to set the
filetype-filter to "all"). Click on a line with J code and press
ctrl+enter
to execute it.
Covered builtins are listed in the appendix with a short description.
Important links:
Project Homepage:
https://jsoftware.com
Online J interpreter:
https://jsoftware.github.io/j-playground/bin/html2/
All builtin operators
, with links to their wiki pages:
https://code.jsoftware.com/wiki/NuVoc
Good old wiki:
https://www.jsoftware.com/help/dictionary/contents.htm
Cheatsheet/Reference Card (not for beginners):
https://code.jsoftware.com/wiki/File:B.A4.pdf
History:
J was first released in 1990 as a successor to APL, an alternative
mathematical notation that is computer-executable and works well with
multi-dimensional array data. Most notably J switches from APL's custom
symbol-set to ASCII only, calling most basic builtins by a single symbol
or a symbol with appended dot or colon, and giving distinct meaning to
single symbols that usually appear in pairs like various braces and
quotes (
[]"{}
etc).
Comments:
NB.
comments the rest of the line (latin: nota bene).
Numbers:
J has many number-notations; the most important are:

NB.
float
_3
NB.
negative numbers start with underscore
_
NB.
sole underscore is infinity: a number

NB.
negative infinity
12j34
NB.
complex number (sometimes used as argument pair)
16bcoffee
NB.
base-16 number (must be lowercase)
Lists, Booleans:
The notation is simple: just put elements next to each other. All
elements must to have the same type but as an empty list has no elements
it can be combined with any other list. True and false are represented
simply by the two numbers
1
and
0
. See also: strings
0

Strings:
Strings are lists thus an empty string is commonly used as empty list
notation. The default string type is called "literal" and is UTF-8
encoded which means the first 128 ASCII characters work well with arrays
as they are a single byte long. String literals are singlequoted, and
only this character is special; it is escaped by doubling it. See also:
string representation and unicode
'

Nouns:
Nouns
are data values such as the ones covered until now.
Boxes
,
which will be covered later, are nouns too. Lists are actually just a
basic case of
arrays
which can be thought of as nested lists.
Classes and their instances aren't nouns: they cannot be referenced
directly; but their name can be saved as a string.
Functions aren't nouns either; but by putting them into a special kind
of list,
gerunds
, they can effectively be made one (also covered
below).
Special data types:
J comes with some specialized data types, which wont be covered here,
but shall at least be mentioned:
Symbols
: They are a specialized type of string, which is
immutable, treated as a single element and has optimized performance
with searching, sorting and comparison operations. However, only a
few, often used ones should be created, as they are registered in a
global table and cannot be removed from it anymore. More info at:
https://code.jsoftware.com/wiki/Vocabulary/sco

data.title: What went wrong with wireless USB
data.author: goldenskye
data.article_summary: 本文简要探讨了无线USB技术的历史和其消亡原因，以及与Wi-Fi和蓝牙的比较。作者最初尝试通过Palm OS智能手表进行移动网络连接，但设备缺乏内置网络功能。作者设想通过无线USB解决这一问题，回顾了无线USB曾短暂存在的平行技术世界。无线USB基于超宽带（UWB）技术，旨在提供短距离高带宽通信。然而，由于竞争标准和Wi-Fi的普及，无线USB很快在市场上消失。文章还解释了窄带和宽带无线电传输的区别，以及UWB与雷达脉冲技术的渊源。最终，Wi-Fi和蓝牙的普及使得无线USB未能广泛应用。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：无线USB技术的发展、应用及争议

不同观点：
• **Variaga**：认为无线USB技术在2008-2010年期间功能上可行，但未能广泛普及，主要问题在于USB接口同时提供电力，而无线USB仍需通过线缆供电，降低了其价值。此外，还存在“鸡生蛋、蛋生鸡”的采用困境，制造商不愿增加成本去支持一个没有必须外设的技术，而外设厂商也不愿生产无线USB设备。
• **Jauntywundrkind**：提到了无线USB之后的802.11ad和802.11ay（WiGig）技术，这些技术在视频传输和VR应用中得到了使用。同时提到无线USB的替代方案如USB over IP，以及低功耗UWB技术的发展，希望看到更多通用外设互联的应用。
• **M000**：认为无线USB是“锤子法则”（即“如果你只有锤子，所有问题看起来都像钉子”）的案例，USB-IF过于注重硬件解决方案，而忽视了软件解决方案如USB over IP。在ARM架构的单板计算机（SBCs）和WiFi普及的时代，无线USB未能适应新的技术趋势。
• **Marsymars**：提到2017年的Essential Phone使用了无线USB技术进行模块化配件的数据传输，但实际应用非常有限。
• **Brudgers**：认为无线USB听起来很吸引人，但实际上并没有解决重要的实际问题，只是一种“听起来像未来”的噱头，因为无线USB只能消除一根USB线，而WiFi已经能很好地完成类似任务。
• **Liftyee**：对无线传输的带宽限制表示关注，并希望深入理解其中的技术限制。
• **Londons_explore**：主张现代无线协议应支持全IP网络，以实现更多连接可能性。例如无线USB打印机只能单主机连接，而支持IP的打印机可以全网络使用。

补充讨论：
• **Ajross**：提到无线USB的竞争技术在遥控车领域（如Spektrum无线电）仍有应用，表明部分无线USB芯片技术在其他市场得以延续。
• **Kensai**：质疑无线USB是否因为标准进展缓慢和竞争标准（如WiFi和蓝牙）的优势而未能普及，并询问关于不同无线标准在实际使用中的能耗对比。
• **Shahzaibmushtaq**：认为在某些情况下，即插即用的有线接口仍然优于无线媒介。

争议焦点：
• 无线USB未能普及的原因：技术本身的缺陷（如供电问题）、市场采用困境（鸡生蛋问题）、以及与其他无线技术（如WiFi、蓝牙）的竞争。
• 无线USB的价值：部分评论认为无线USB只是噱头，没有解决实际问题，而其他评论则认可其技术创新和潜力，尤其是在特定应用场景中。

43883902.article_content:
(Hat tip to the late Bill Strauss and The Capitol Steps' Lirty Dies.)
A few moons ago I was thinking of ways to
take my Palm OS Fossil Wrist PDA smartwatch mobile
. It has no on-board networking libraries but can be coerced into doing PPP over its serial port (via USB) by using the libraries from my Palm m505. Of course, that then requires it be constantly connected to a USB port, which is rather inconvenient for a wristwatch.
But what if the USB connection could be made
wirelessly
? For a few years, real honest-to-goodness wireless USB devices were actually a thing. Competing standards led to market fracture and the technologies fizzled out relatively quickly in the marketplace, but like the
parallel universe of FireWire hubs
there was another parallel world of wireless USB devices, at least for a few years. As it happens, we now have a couple of them here, so it's worth exploring what wireless USB was and what happened to it, how the competing standards worked (and how well), and if it would have helped.
You can probably blame Wi-Fi for this: while early patents for Wi-Fi existed as far back as 1991, after the introduction of 802.11 in 1997 and Apple's use of 802.11b
for the iBook G3 in 1999
people really started to believe a completely wireless future was possible — for
any
device. This was nevertheless another type of network, just one involving only one computer and one user over a short range, which was grandiosely dubbed the "personal area network," or PAN, or WPAN, depending on executive and blood alcohol level. Although initial forms of Bluetooth were the first to arrive in this space, Bluetooth was never intended to handle the very high data rates that some wireless peripherals might require, and even modern high-speed Bluetooth isn't specced beyond 50 megabits/sec (though hold that thought for a later digression). The key basis technology instead was the concept of ultra wide-band, or UWB, which in modern parlance collectively refers to technologies allowing very weak, very wide-spectrum (in excess of 500MHz) signals to become a short range yet high bandwidth communications channel.
Wideband, in this case, is contrasted against the more typical narrowband. In general radio transmission works by modulating a carrier wave of a specified frequency, changing its amplitude (AM), phase, and/or the frequency itself (FM), to encode a signal to be communicated. For terrestrial analogue broadcasting, a good example of narrowband radio, this might be an audio signal carrying some specified frequency range; for FM radio in the United States this audio signal ranges from 30Hz to 15kHz, enough to capture much of the human-audible range, plus various higher frequencies not intended for listening. This collective signal effectively becomes encoded into
sidebands
on one or both sides of the carrier frequency (even with AM), and per Carson's rule the higher the maximum modulated frequency of the encoded signal then the larger the sidebands (ergo, its
bandwidth
) must be. As a result, commercial radio stations in particular are often heavily filtered for coexistence to allow many stations to share the band: in the United States, within ITU Region 2, the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) divides the FM band from 88.0MHz to 108.0MHz into 100 "channels" of 200kHz each, putting the nominal carrier frequency in the middle of the channel to provide sufficient sideband width for modulation, and strictly regulates any spillover outside those channel boundaries. In practice, most adjacent U.S. FM stations are no closer than 400kHz, a balance between spectrum capacity and signal strength. This typically permits a maximum FM stereo modulated frequency of about 53kHz; frequencies in the aggregate range being transmitted that are unused or unnecessary can be repurposed as
subcarriers
to emit additional information, such as FM stereo's 19kHz pilot tone subcarrier used to signal receivers, or Microsoft's brief flirtation with one-way transmissions to SPOT smartwatches. Doing so is "free" because the subcarrier frequency is already part of the frequency range.
By contrast, signals like 802.11 Wi-Fi are wideband radio, or at least comparatively wid-
er
band, because they pass much higher bandwidths. Although 802.11 frequencies (except for the very highest 45/60GHz band) are generally divided into 5MHz channels, people typically only use channels 1, 6 and 11 with 2.4GHz Wi-Fi, for example (or, in later standards, 1, 5, 9 and maybe 13), which spaces them by 20MHz or more. Compare this with medium-wave AM radio, where channel spacing in the United States is just 10kHz and even 9kHz in some countries like Australia, or shortwave radio with only 5kHz spacing.
That brings us to UWB. Ultra wideband has its roots in
impulse radar
, which is a form of the more familiar pulsed radar (such as the traffic cop at the corner) using much briefer radio pulses. Radar also works on a carrier wave model, but instead of FM or AM, the radar carri
43883902.article_summary: 本文简要探讨了无线USB技术的历史和其消亡原因，以及与Wi-Fi和蓝牙的比较。作者最初尝试通过Palm OS智能手表进行移动网络连接，但设备缺乏内置网络功能。作者设想通过无线USB解决这一问题，回顾了无线USB曾短暂存在的平行技术世界。无线USB基于超宽带（UWB）技术，旨在提供短距离高带宽通信。然而，由于竞争标准和Wi-Fi的普及，无线USB很快在市场上消失。文章还解释了窄带和宽带无线电传输的区别，以及UWB与雷达脉冲技术的渊源。最终，Wi-Fi和蓝牙的普及使得无线USB未能广泛应用。

data.title: Metagenomics test saves woman's sight after mystery infection
data.author: neversaydie
data.article_summary: 29岁的布里斯托医生Ellie Irwin饱受持续五年的右眼炎症困扰，视力模糊，传统治疗均无效，甚至考虑摘除眼睛。最终，通过一种名为"宏基因组学"的突破性检测，她被诊断出感染了一种罕见的细菌——钩端螺旋体病，使用抗生素后治愈。这种检测通过基因组测序能识别样本中的所有病原体，相比传统方法更精准。Ellie的感染可能源于2018年她在厄瓜多尔和哥伦比亚游泳时感染。虽然每次检测费用高达约1300英镑，但该技术极具诊断潜力。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：罕见病诊断与治疗过程中的挑战及技术应用

不同观点：
• [w10-1] 认为Leptospirosis极为罕见，且通常影响其他组织，因此眼部感染诊断难度大。同时指出，尽管常见有效抗生素，但通过静脉注射可能无法在眼部达到治疗浓度。还提到，代谢基因组学在这种小组织样本的情况下非常有效，因为这些螺旋体太小，光学显微镜难以发现，这可能是实验室漏检的原因。

• [donatj] 质疑为何在五年内没有尝试广谱抗生素治疗，认为这是故事的核心。指出在"最后手段"的代谢基因组学分析后才确诊并治愈，质疑之前的治疗策略。

• [loremm] 认为基因组学领域的工具虽然主要面向科学家，但其协议相对便宜且易于理解，未来在临床应用中会有很大希望。提到一个研究案例，说明快速基因测序在罕见遗传病诊断中的潜力。

• [uxhacker] 认为BBC文章夸大了Great Ormond Street Hospital服务的独特性，指出代谢基因组学已在英国其他地方使用，并提供了相关例子。

• [dtech] 对在未确定病因情况下不尝试抗生素治疗感到困惑，尤其在炎症持续存在时，并质疑为何优先考虑自身免疫疾病。

• [greg] 认为代谢基因组学虽然尚未普及，但已不再是最前沿技术。提到自己参与的项目提供免费代谢基因组学分析，并表示会为亲友的疑难病症考虑使用此技术。

• [epmaybe] 作为眼科医生，为涉及的专科医生辩护，指出诊断的困难性，并强调在疑似感染时抗生素使用的复杂性及抗药性问题。

• [patrickhogan1] 指出常规多西环素治疗为5-7天，而患者使用了21天，推测可能之前已尝试过抗生素治疗。

• [animal531] 分享个人眼疾经历，与讨论案例无直接关系，但提供了患者视角的困扰。

• [pton_xd] 质疑医生是否总是询问国际旅行史，认为这是诊断不明疾病的重要细节。

• [bsder] 认为热带地区旅行史会引发对多种罕见病的怀疑，而这些病通常难以确诊。

• [raincom] 强调代谢基因组学技术通过基因组测序识别病原体的优势，指出传统测试方法的局限性。

• [sleepyguy] 好奇最初是否诊断为葡萄膜炎并开始治疗，惊讶于未提及感染病专家会诊，并比较加拿大在处理复杂问题时的多专家会诊模式。

补充讨论：
- 争议焦点在于为何五年内未尝试广谱抗生素治疗以及对专科医生的质疑与辩护。
- 代谢基因组学技术的应用潜力及其在临床实践中的局限性。
- 国际旅行史在诊断罕见热带病中的重要性。

43842367.article_content:
Image caption,
Dr Ellie Irwin's sight has been saved after a test pinpointed the cause of her long-lasting eye inflammation
Fergus Walsh
Medical editor
Published
30 April 2025
A 29-year-old doctor from Bristol has had her eyesight saved after a "game-changing" test identified a mystery infection that had plagued her health for five years.
Ellie Irwin suffered persistent inflammation in her right eye that didn't go away, resulting in blurred vision. No treatment helped and at one point she even considered having her eye removed.
It was only after Ellie was offered a "last resort" analysis called metagenomics, that she was diagnosed with a rare bacterial infection which was cured with antibiotics.
"It's been transformative," Ellie told the BBC. "I feel so fortunate."
Professor Carlos Pavesio, consultant ophthalmologist at Moorfields Eye Hospital in London, says Ellie's case is a "breakthrough in the diagnosis of infectious diseases".
"There are many patients we treat with chronic infections for years, but despite multiple tests we cannot identify the bug responsible," he says.
In 2019, while still at medical school, Ellie began suffering from inflammation in her right eye. All tests for infection came back negative and it was assumed she had an autoimmune condition.
Ellie was prescribed steroid eye drops and immunosuppressants, some of which needed to be given by intravenous infusion.
"It was completely dominating my life," Ellie says. "I needed eye drops every single hour and it was difficult to balance that alongside starting work as a junior doctor. My vision was really variable, and I would have some bad days.
"I was on so much medication and going to so many appointments, yet I didn't feel I was getting any better."
The treatment and inflammation led to Ellie developing a cataract that had to be surgically removed, just after she graduated from medical school.
Ellie says she eventually reached "breaking point", and even began considering having her affected eye removed.
"Whilst losing sight in one eye is terrifying," she says, "my biggest fear was that it might spread to my left eye."
Image source,
Ellie Irwin
Image caption,
Ellie's eye developed a cataract that had to be removed
It was one of Ellie's doctors at Southmead Hospital in Bristol who suggested metagenomics - a last resort test not generally available to patients and only used where standard diagnostic tools have failed to identify or rule out infection.
Metagenomics technology uses cutting-edge genomic sequencing, which can identify all bacteria, fungi or parasites present in a sample by comparing them against a database of millions of pathogens.
A team at Moorfields Eye Hospital arranged for a sample of fluid to be taken from inside Ellie's eye and sent to the metagenomics labs at Great Ormond Street Hospital (GOSH) - the only lab in the UK officially recognised to carry out these diagnostic tests for patients, and one of only a few in the world.
Currently, the standard method for detecting bacterial infections is by trying to grow a sample of it in a Petri dish.
For viruses, the most common diagnostic tool is a PCR test. These will be familiar to many from the pandemic, when millions sent off swabs in the post to confirm whether they had Covid.
However, Dr Julianne Brown, principal clinical scientist at the GOSH metagenomics service, says PCR has some drawbacks.
"The trouble with PCR is that you have to think of the viruses that might be causing an infection and do a separate test for each and every one," she says. "So if you've got an infection with something that's unexpected, rare or not previously known, you won't find it."
Dr Brown says metagenomics is "an enormous step up - it's a complete game-changer".
Image source,
Ellie Irwin
Image caption,
Doctors believe Ellie's eye condition was caused by an infection she caught while swimming in the Amazon
In Ellie's case, metagenomics diagnosed a rare strain of the bacterial infection leptospirosis found in South America.
It is now presumed Ellie picked up the bug swimming in the Amazon river in 2018, while on a trip to Ecuador and Colombia.
Ellie says it was an emotional moment when she was given the results of the test.
"I broke down - I just had to cry. I never imagined that it would come back positive and be for something that was treatable," she says.
"I was given three weeks of antibiotics and within days my vision was clearer and the inflammation subsided."
A single metagenomics test costs around Â£1,300, which is far more than standard diagnostics. However, as the technology is developed that price is likely to fall rapidly.
Virologist Professor Judy Breuer, who has been developing metagenomics at GOSH and University College London (UCL) for more than a decade, says her team currently receives three or four samples a week from hospitals around the UK for metagenomic testing in addition to those it carries out on its own patients.

data.title: A simple Common Lisp web app
data.author: silcoon
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了如何使用Common Lisp创建一个简单的网页应用（guestbook），重点解决了Common Lisp文档不足的问题。作者首先指出了Common Lisp库文档不完善的缺点，使得初学者难以入门，并决定编写一个教程。教程要求读者安装SBCL、Quicklisp和必要的IDE插件。接着，作者详细描述了创建项目、设置Quicklisp、配置依赖库的步骤，并展示了如何使用`cl-project`生成项目骨架。然后，作者解释了如何编写核心代码，包括启动和停止服务器，使用Lack和Clack库来处理中间件和静态资源。最终实现了一个简单的网页应用框架，包含模板渲染、数据库查询和路由暴露等功能。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Common Lisp在现代Web应用开发中的适用性及相关工具和资源

不同观点：

One of the drawbacks of dealing with Common Lisp is the lack of documentation available. Too often, I find published libraries without an explanation of how to use them or only partially documented, and I need to dig into the source code to understand how they work or if that method is present or not. data.title: Brian Eno's Theory of Democracy
data.author: akkartik
data.article_summary: 文章探讨了布莱恩·伊诺（Brian Eno）的艺术观点如何间接反映了他对民主的看法，并结合了政治学家亚当·普热沃斯基（Adam Przeworski）的民主理论。普热沃斯基在其1991年著作《民主与市场》中提出，民主是一种“政党会输掉选举”的制度，并通过博弈论解释了民主的稳定性源于执政党在未来可能重新掌权的预期和不确定性。这种理论将复杂的政治行为简化为一个简单的九字命题，并强调民主的持续性依赖于权力交替的预期和不确定性。然而，这一理论无法完全解释近年来美国等国民主倒退的现象，表明民主的稳定性可能还需要考虑更多外部冲击和其他因素。文章认为，伊诺的艺术理念与这种民主理论有相通之处，强调了多样性和组织在政治中的重要性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同政治制度及其面临的挑战，包括民主、专制、法西斯主义等，以及技术和社会变化对这些制度的影响。

不同观点：
• dzink认为，民主通过给予每个人投票权来确保掌权者接受反馈，而不确定性使掌权者更可能听取反馈。相比之下，专制者只接受来自政治或经济利益相关者的反馈，并通过暴力和媒体控制保持权力。
• keiferski指出，随着识字率下降，民主（Democracy）和权力扩散过程（democracy）之间的区别被模糊了。技术本应是民主化的力量，但在政治系统中却未实现这种潜力。
• selecsosi引用了Joseph Tainter的分析，认为社会崩溃与边际收益递减有关，政治党派的议程往往试图从有限的资源中榨取更多。
• antics9支持基本收入和社区在孕育思想中的作用，认为新思想通常由社区生成。
• chaosprint分享了在音乐表演实践中应用不同组织方式的经验，特别是通过代码控制声音的实验，强调了社会规则在技术系统中的重要性。
• whatever1认为，民主和权力分立代表了一种防止社会自我毁灭的机制，尽管它不稳定且昂贵。
• kstenerud反驳认为，民主不能孤立存在，外部竞争和压力影响其运作，尤其是美国的两党制加剧了 polarization。
• James_K批评美国的两党制导致政党没有动力改进，因为它们依赖私人捐赠维持运作。
• t0bia_s强调，民主的真正考验在于权力的和平过渡，而不是第一次选举。
• emsign警告，专制者和法西斯主义者通过让人们怀疑选举结果的合法性来破坏民主。
• thrance认为，民主的不稳定源于经济阶级间的权力不平衡，特别是资本积累在少数人手中的问题。

• 不同评论者对民主制度的优缺点进行了深入分析，尤其是其在面对经济不平等和外部压力时的脆弱性。
• 技术在民主化和专制化过程中的双重作用被多次提及，强调了技术对政治系统的影响。
• 经济不平等和社会分裂被认为是导致民主不稳定和法西斯主义崛起的重要因素。

争议焦点：
• 民主制度是否能有效应对当前的经济和社会挑战。
• 技术是否促进了民主化进程，或者反而加剧了不平等和社会分裂。
• 外部压力和两党制对民主运作的影响程度。

Organizing and generating variety in politics
Henry Farrell
May 01, 2025

[image by Brian Eno, from “77 Million Paintings.” Eno says
in this dialogue
that he doesn’t mind people using these images for non-commercial purposes]
Subscribe
This post’s title is a little cheeky. Brian Eno does not have an explicit theory of democracy that I know of, although he is visibly and emphatically committed to its practice. But Eno’s arguments about the arts tell us important things about how democracy ought work, and what kinds of democratic stability and variety we ought aspire to.
The back story to this post doesn’t start with Brian Eno. Back in 1991, the political scientist Adam Przeworski published a book,
Democracy and the Market
. Most of the book was about the democratic transition in Central and Eastern Europe, and it was very good as best as I can judge these things. But the first chapter was much,
much
better than very good. It laid out a brief theory of democracy that reshaped the ways in which political scientists think about it.
Przeworski’s theory
starts from a simple seeming claim
: that “democracy is a system in which parties lose elections.” It then uses a combination of game theory and informal argument to lay out the implications. If we assume (as Przeworski assumes) that parties and political decision makers are self-centered, why would the ruling party ever accept that they had lost and relinquish control of government? Przeworski argues that it must somehow be in their self-interest to so. He argues that they will admit defeat if they see that the alternative is worse, and (this is crucial) because democracy generates sufficient uncertainty about the future that they believe they might win in some future election. They know that they will hurt their interests if they refuse to give in, and they have some (unquantifiable but real) prospect of coming back into power again. Democracy, then, will be stable so long as the expectation of costs and the uncertainty of the future give the losers sufficient incentive to accept that they have lost.
This is a more beautiful idea than I am able to explain in a brief post, and certainly much more beautiful than any argument I will ever come up with myself. It compresses a vast and turbid system of enmeshed ambitions and behaviors into a deceptively simple nine word thesis. That thesis can then be unfolded into a variety of more detailed models of how democracy may sustain itself through the interlocking ambitions of politicians who strive to win office, but grudgingly accept that they must leave it if they lose. If Przeworski’s argument is not well known outside political science, it is likely because it is a chapter in a book that is mostly about different questions from a different time. But within political science, it is rightly regarded as a classic. If you have a Ph.D. in comparative politics, or even a good undergraduate degree, you will likely have been required to read it as a photocopy or a PDF.
Equally, Przeworski’s argument leads you to think about democracy in some ways, and not others. It suggests that the central elements of democracy are a set of self-reinforcing expectations about the alternation of power, which can be mapped with game theory. Many political scientists were inspired by Przeworski’s ideas to come up with more formal models of democracy, ditching Przeworski’s claims about uncertainty and informal arguments in favor of greater determinacy and cleaner math. Personally, I think that Przeworski’s initial, messier formulation better captures some of the dynamics of the system,.
This understanding implies that as soon as democracy has become established, it will continue to work into the indefinite future, because everyone’s expectations converge in ways that reinforce each other.  Once a democracy has become sufficiently wealthy and established, parties and leaders should recognize that they have too much to lose from destabilizing the system. It would take a massive external shock (e.g. a major economic crisis), remaking the environment that democracy works in, to shift people out of their ordinary beliefs and behaviors.
These assumptions mostly stem from the way that game theorists think about the world. In their language, democracy is a self enforcing equilibrium, which will just keep on going so long as the parameter values don’t shift too radically. You don’t have to worry too much about destabilizing forces emerging from
within
democracy.
Unfortunately, it has become clear to many (including Przeworski himself) that this understanding can’t really explain why democracy is degenerating in the U.S. and elsewhere. Look around you: there are visibly circumstances under which democracy

• [roflcopter69] 认为该编辑器目前功能较为基础，但有潜力，并推荐了另一个像素艺术编辑器 Pixelorama，认为其具有更多功能和社区支持，且使用 Godot 引擎开发是其优点。
• [sabslikesobs] 分享了自己使用 Krita 进行像素艺术创作的体验，指出 Krita 的一些强大功能如批量导出插件和自定义笔刷，适合低分辨率绘画。
• [neuroelectron] 对现代像素艺术风格的真实像素网格对齐和分辨率限制提出疑问，建议开发一种具有640x480分辨率和扫描线模拟效果的工具。
• [prashnts] 提出为移动用户增加触摸操作支持的具体建议，以改善用户体验。
• [PeterHolzwarth] 回顾了经典的 Deluxe Paint III 像素编辑器，认为其是30年前最好的像素编辑工具。
• [vunderba] 强调了像素艺术编辑器中多缩放级别实时预览功能的重要性，以帮助创作者在游戏环境中查看作品效果。
• [somefuckingguy] 分享了自己开发的类似工具，具有动画功能，并提供了相关链接供参考。
• [hombre_fatal] 认为该项目目前状态过于简单，不值得分享，并对提及无关游戏 Octopath Traveler II 表示不满。
• [christophilus] 借机表达了对游戏公司 Square 近期3D重制的失望，希望其能用类似 Octopath 的风格重制经典游戏。
• [socalgal2] 对使用 Netify 而非 GitHub Pages 托管静态页面提出疑问，询问是否有后续功能开发计划。

补充讨论：
• [kubb] 作为一个像素艺术新手，询问学习像素艺术的建议和流程。
• [ThinkBeat] 作为一个工具新手，询问如何在编辑器中添加更多瓷砖（tiles），显示出对工具使用的不熟悉。
• [emigre] 和 [shawn_w] 简单表达了对该编辑器的喜爱和赞赏。

争议焦点：
• [hombre_fatal] 对项目当前状态和无关联游戏的提及表示不满，认为这是不必要的关联尝试。
• 不同用户对像素艺术工具的功能和使用场景有不同偏好，如 [roflcopter69] 推荐 Pixelorama 而 [sabslikesobs] 偏好 Krita。

data.title: Hello My Perverted Friend
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 本文由Dr. Neal Krawetz撰写，介绍了他如何开始开发取证工具的经历。他在1988年莫里斯蠕虫事件期间开始关注计算机安全，但直到十年后追踪垃圾邮件发送者时，才正式开始开发这些工具。Krawetz详细描述了垃圾邮件中的隐藏信息（秘密通道），例如通过伪造邮件头和重复使用的垃圾邮件进行隐蔽通信。他发现了一些组织，包括菲律宾的小学生团体以及犯罪组织和国家支持的行动者，利用这些秘密通道传递信息。随着垃圾邮件过滤器的改进，这种秘密通信逐渐消失。如今，垃圾邮件的数量和明显骗局已大大减少，但Krawetz仍在分析剩余垃圾邮件是否存在其他动机，如敲诈。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：垃圾邮件中的隐藏信息和诈骗行为的动机及有效性

不同观点：
• [breakingcups] 怀疑所谓垃圾邮件中的“隐藏信息”以及后续勒索邮件的复杂动机。他们认为，许多垃圾邮件发送者只是模仿他人行为的青少年，而非具有深谋远虑的聪明人。垃圾邮件发送者往往是新手，试图通过大量发送邮件来获得成功。
• [ivraatiems] 认为诈骗邮件之所以存在，是因为它们在某种程度上有效。即使回复率极低，发送成本也很低，因此只要有一小部分人上当受骗，诈骗者就能获利。同时，他们对为何有人会相信并支付表示困惑，并怀疑是否存在比勒索更好的诈骗方式。
• [cheschire] 认为，尽管勒索行为难以防范，但垃圾邮件和垃圾电话依然广泛存在，可能是因为它们提供了某种程度的匿名性。相比之下，定向勒索风险更大，可能暴露更多犯罪信息。
• [OuterVale] 指出特定类型的垃圾邮件非常普遍，且多年保持基本不变，只是稍作修改。他们观察到，某些邮箱每天会收到大量相同内容的邮件。

补充讨论：
• [genewitch] 对垃圾邮件中存在隐秘信息的说法表示嘲讽，暗示这种想法过于夸张。
• [immibis] 分享了自己收到与电动自行车相关的垃圾邮件的经历，并对为何有人会通过垃圾邮件购买商品表示不解。他们还提到，某些邮件可能只是用于测试邮件服务器等技术目的。

争议焦点：
• 垃圾邮件发送者的真实身份和动机：一方认为他们是试图模仿成功案例的青少年，另一方则认为诈骗邮件是经过精心设计的，具有特定目的。
• 垃圾邮件的有效性和持续存在的原因：讨论了为何垃圾邮件依然普遍存在，以及为何简单的诈骗手段仍然有效。

Hello my perverted friend
Saturday,  3 May 2025
At conferences and when first meeting customers, I'm often asked how I got started developing forensic tools. I've been involved in computer security since before "computer security" became a term of art. (People didn't really think about 'computer security' until the
Morris Worm
in 1988. I was in college when
that
happened. It was exciting!) However, I didn't start developing forensic tools until a decade later, when I started tracking down spammers. It's been nearly 30 years and I still read, classify, and archive every spam message that I receive.
Sometimes I wonder why spammers still do it, and the answer isn't always obvious. Back in 2003/2004, I gave a presentations on covert channels in spam. I had identified over a dozen groups that were hiding messages in spam. The basic gist:
Back then, anyone could forge the email sender. This meant that the sender was anonymous. (Newer technologies, like SPF (2014) and DKIM (2011), put a stop to completely forged headers.)
The emails were sent to a large mailing list. Most of the recipients were chaff; only a few addresses in the list were intentional. Unfortunately, nobody (except the sender) had the entire list, so no external observer could identify the intended recipients. This made the intended recipient anonymous.
The covert message would be hidden somewhere in the email -- in the header, subject, or buried in the content. If you didn't know to look for it, you wouldn't see it.
Any email message would work, but spam was ideal. The sender could re-use any spam message as camouflage. The unintended recipients (regular people) had already been trained to see and delete spam, so nobody (well, except me) would look closely enough to see the covert message.
I had been categorizing spam based on the sending tool signatures (email headers) and spam contents. The re-used spam messages really stood out. "Hey, that content is from the guy in Detroit, but that's not his tool signature!" The first time I had a mismatch, it was a covert channel and I could see the hidden message plain as day. At the time, I had been hanging out in hacker forums, where people write in "
leet speak
" (replacing letters with similar shaped characters, phonetic spelling, and horrific abbreviations). The message was in leet:
[gvjrFov-ka1AsHb3-oOGIgZSseoUJF]
It translates as:
[gvjr Fov - ka1AsH b3 - oO G I gZSseo UJF]
[Governor of - class B - oh gee I guess UJF]
A few days later, I saw this message:
[whQZsFOtOcY-AWw9fYuTUvLS-EBdh4gbj2Py5H]
It translates as:
[whQZs FOtO cY - AW w9f Yu TUvLS - EBdh4gbj2 Py5H]
[Who's photo Cy? I love your tools -
something in Tagalog
Psych]
Long story short, this series of messages came from a group of Filipino elementary school kids having fun with covert messages in spam. (They called themselves "The Hangouters" because they would hang out together. "Cy" was short for Cybersad. She was the collector and distributor of tools for the group.) While unintentional, these kids showed me how to spot covert messages. As soon as you can see it, you start seeing it often. (This is the
Baader-Meinhof Phenomenon
or "red car theory"; when you learn to see it, you notice it more often.) I quickly identified a few other 'covert channels in spam' groups, including organized crime, nation-state actors, and other organizations. It wasn't just kids.
Covert channels in spam dried up when spam filters got better. I mean, there's no point in sending hidden messages in spam if some upstream filter silently blocks the spam and prevents the intended recipient from seeing the message.
The volume of spam today is nothing like it was a few decades ago. A lot of the obvious scams are either gone or significantly reduced in volume. For the ones that are left, I have to wonder if there is an ulterior motive?
Extortion(?)
The other day I received a fun spam message:
Date: Tue, 29 Apr 2025 10:36:41 +0300
From: Dawson Monroe <[REDACTED]@piplslovers.ru>
To: [REDACTED]@[REDACTED].com
Subject: New Message
Well, hello there, my per

data.title: Elvish – Scripting language and interactive shell
data.author: kartikarti
data.article_summary: Elvish 是一个强大的脚本语言和多功能交互式 shell，支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 和 Windows。它尚未发布 1.0 版本，但已足够稳定，可用于脚本编写和交互操作。Elvish 提供详细的用户文档和开发文档，源码采用 BSD-2-Clause 许可，部分代码基于 Go 和 Clojure 等项目，采用不同许可。Elvish 拥有 5.9k 个星标和 311 个分支，由 95 位贡献者开发，主要使用 Go 语言编写。项目网站为 [elv.sh](http://elv.sh)。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同用户对Elvish及其他新型shell的看法和使用体验

不同观点：
• [对Elvish的正面评价]  
  - [xiaq] 作为Elvish的作者，提到Elvish每年都会在HN上被讨论，暗示其具有一定的社区关注度。  
  - [atiq-ca] 对Elvish表示兴趣，并询问其是否具有类似Powershell的面向对象功能，表明对这种特性的潜在需求。

• [对Elvish的负面评价和失望]  
  - [Arcuru] 虽然尝试了多种新型shell（oils/ysh, elvish, xonsh），但觉得这些shell引入了一种既不是Python也不是传统shell的语言，增加了学习成本，最终选择fish和Python结合使用，避免使用额外的shell特性。  
  - [photonthug] 认为Elvish的文档写得过于啰嗦，增加了理解难度，尤其是对外部命令的解释让人困惑，甚至怀疑文档是否由AI生成。  
  - [rendaw] 对Elvish非常失望，指出其文档不完整、缺乏后台任务支持、shell钩子有未说明的限制等问题，认为该项目"半生不熟且已停止发展"。

• [对其他shell的偏好]  
  - [gatane] 偏好使用来自Plan9的rc shell，认为它比bash和其他shell更简单，同时提供了必要的功能如函数、for循环和列表。  
  - [linsomniac] 认为zsh已经"足够好"，结合一些插件能提供如fish的优点而没有其缺点，表示没有必要切换到其他新型shell。  
  - [account-5] 喜欢Nushell，因为它改进了bash的一些痛点，并将数据格式作为一等公民，同时指出Elvish在数据解析上的不足。

• [对比与选择困难]  
  - [IshKebab] 认为Elvish比bash好，但市场上还有其他优于bash的选择，需要更多理由来说服用户选择Elvish而非Nushell。  
  - [baobun] 询问是否有用户在日常使用Elvish，希望通过他人经验来判断其价值。

补充讨论：
- Elvish的文档问题是一个争议焦点，部分用户认为其难以理解且过于冗长。
- 不同用户对新型shell的需求和偏好各异，有的追求简单和熟悉（如zsh、rc shell），有的希望有更强大的内置数据处理能力（如Nushell、Powershell）。
- Elvish的开发状态受到质疑，一些用户认为其发展停滞且功能不全。

43843902.article_summary: Elvish 是一个强大的脚本语言和多功能交互式 shell，支持 Linux、BSD、macOS 和 Windows。它尚未发布 1.0 版本，但已足够稳定，可用于脚本编写和交互操作。Elvish 提供详细的用户文档和开发文档，源码采用 BSD-2-Clause 许可，部分代码基于 Go 和 Clojure 等项目，采用不同许可。Elvish 拥有 5.9k 个星标和 311 个分支，由 95 位贡献者开发，主要使用 Go 语言编写。项目网站为 [elv.sh](http://elv.sh)。
43843902.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：不同用户对Elvish及其他新型shell的看法和使用体验

不同观点：
• [对Elvish的正面评价]  
  - [xiaq] 作为Elvish的作者，提到Elvish每年都会在HN上被讨论，暗示其具有一定的社区关注度。  
  - [atiq-ca] 对Elvish表示兴趣，并询问其是否具有类似Powershell的面向对象功能，表明对这种特性的潜在需求。

• [对Elvish的负面评价和失望]  
  - [Arcuru] 虽然尝试了多种新型shell（oils/ysh, elvish, xonsh），但觉得这些shell引入了一种既不是Python也不是传统shell的语言，增加了学习成本，最终选择fish和Python结合使用，避免使用额外的shell特性。  
  - [photonthug] 认为Elvish的文档写得过于啰嗦，增加了理解难度，尤其是对外部命令的解释让人困惑，甚至怀疑文档是否由AI生成。  
  - [rendaw] 对Elvish非常失望，指出其文档不完整、缺乏后台任务支持、shell钩子有未说明的限制等问题，认为该项目"半生不熟且已停止发展"。

• [对其他shell的偏好]  
  - [gatane] 偏好使用来自Plan9的rc shell，认为它比bash和其他shell更简单，同时提供了必要的功能如函数、for循环和列表。  
  - [linsomniac] 认为zsh已经"足够好"，结合一些插件能提供如fish的优点而没有其缺点，表示没有必要切换到其他新型shell。  
  - [account-5] 喜欢Nushell，因为它改进了bash的一些痛点，并将数据格式作为一等公民，同时指出Elvish在数据解析上的不足。

• [对比与选择困难]  
  - [IshKebab] 认为Elvish比bash好，但市场上还有其他优于bash的选择，需要更多理由来说服用户选择Elvish而非Nushell。  
  - [baobun] 询问是否有用户在日常使用Elvish，希望通过他人经验来判断其价值。

补充讨论：
- Elvish的文档问题是一个争议焦点，部分用户认为其难以理解且过于冗长。
- 不同用户对新型shell的需求和偏好各异，有的追求简单和熟悉（如zsh、rc shell），有的希望有更强大的内置数据处理能力（如Nushell、Powershell）。
- Elvish的开发状态受到质疑，一些用户认为其发展停滞且功能不全。

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于LLM（大型语言模型）能力评估基准的有效性和预测价值

不同观点：
• [hatefulmoron] 认为Y轴应代表模型在循环任务中的实际进展能力，即模型能否在一段时间内自主解决问题。他对当前模型的表现感到失望，并认为自己未仔细查看细节是问题所在。

• [aoeusnth1] 支持当前的基准，认为任务成功率50%的基准是有预测价值的，尽管有人批评任务时长不能完全代表任务难度。他指出，尽管有许多因素影响任务难度，但平均任务时长仍然是衡量难度的好指标。他批评Gary Marcus的观点，认为其忽略了基准的预测能力。

• [yorwba] 建议通过收集不同难度的任务来测试AI的表现，尤其是那些人类表现较好但AI表现较差的任务。这将有助于明确AI当前的局限性，而不是简单地否定所有进展。

• [sandspar] 对Gary Marcus的批评持嘲讽态度，认为其观点过于可预测和重复，建议其不必详细撰写文章，因为结论总是相同。

• [Nivge] 认为基准是基于特定数据集的，虽然不能完全代表AI的整体进展，但仍有其价值和意义。

• [Sharlin] 暗示对某些人未考虑特定软件任务的基准可能不适用于所有认知任务表示不满，似乎对这种局限性并不意外。

• [dist-epoch] 指出某些批评可能基于过时的信息，并提供了一个链接，显示ChatGPT已经通过了某个被认为失败的测试，暗示讨论应基于最新数据。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于任务时长是否是衡量AI能力的有效指标，以及当前基准是否具有足够的代表性和预测价值。
• 一些评论者如[aoeusnth1]和[Nivge]认为基准尽管有局限性，但仍有价值，而[hatefulmoron]和[sandspar]则对基准和AI表现持怀疑或批评态度。
• [yorwba]和[dist-epoch]更关注于实际任务的表现和最新数据，以评估模型的能力。

data.title: An Alabama landline that keeps ringing
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary:
《阿拉巴马州的固定电话依旧响铃》  
作者：Emily McCrary  
2025年4月23日

在奥本大学的Foy信息台，自1953年以来，这个电话服务一直为公众开放。学生们轮流值班，接听各种奇怪的问题，如法律、电子游戏甚至超自然现象。尽管时代变迁，信息台从过去的参考书堆变成了现在的iMac电脑，但电话号码始终未变：(334) 844-4244。

每天，学生们要接听各类问题，从药物用途到房产价格，甚至是恶作剧电话。对于全球一些无法或不愿使用互联网的人来说，这些学生就像“人肉搜索引擎”。员工手册简单，主要规则是保持礼貌，遇到冒犯性问题可挂断电话。

晚上九点后，信息台变得安静，但像Beulah这样的常客会打来长电话，聊她的宠物和生活中的小麻烦。尽管她的背景成谜，学生们依然耐心倾听。这个电话服务已成为连接不同人群的独特桥梁。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于奥本大学Foy咨询台的历史、功能及与现代信息获取方式的对比

不同观点：
• 一些评论者分享了他们在2000年代初期作为志愿者或学生使用Foy咨询台的个人经历。例如，RebeccaTheDev提到当时学生经常询问课程时间或地点，而有些学生因为缺乏计算机技能或设备，不得不依赖人工服务（如Foy咨询台）获取信息。
• dabluecaboose则提到在2010年代初，智能手机互联网尚不发达，学生们仍通过Foy咨询台解决争论。

• 另一部分评论者讨论了Foy咨询台与现代信息获取方式的对比。masto认为从人工查询到搜索引擎查询是信息获取的“巅峰”，而现在由于垃圾信息和生成式AI的泛滥，信息质量正在下降。这个观点引发了对未来信息获取方式的思考，认为未来可能需要重新依赖人工帮助或图书馆。

• 另有一些评论将Foy咨询台与历史上其他类似的服务（如NY公共图书馆服务、RPI的类似系统）进行类比，讨论这些服务在现代技术环境下的命运。AbstractH24好奇Foy咨询台如何适应LLM（大语言模型）时代，而delichon则用幽默的方式指出某些职业或服务（如电梯操作员、煤炭锅炉工）在技术进步中逐渐消失的现象。

• trollbridge提到与Foy咨询台类似的800-GOOG-411服务仅运行了三年就被关闭，对比之下突显了Foy咨询台的长久运营。

补充讨论：
• brudgers分享了关于Foy咨询台命名由来的人物Jim “Dean Foy” Foy的详细背景故事，增加了对该服务历史意义的理解。
• 一些评论者表达了对Foy咨询台及其所代表的时代的情感，如Mistletoe认为保留一些“古旧”的事物（如老式电话）能为世界增添一丝奇妙感。
• 最后，ForOldHack和LadyCailin等评论者以个人经历或幽默的方式表达了对现代技术与过去服务方式差异的看法，强调了对这些古老服务的怀旧情感。

争议焦点：
• 主要集中在现代信息获取方式（如搜索引擎、AI）是否真的优于传统人工服务。masto认为过去的人工查询是信息获取的巅峰，而现代技术环境下的信息质量正在下降，这一观点与其他评论者对现代技术便利性的默认接受形成对比。

43886243.article_content:
The Alabama Landline That Keeps Ringing
Auburn University’s help desk is still answering the public’s calls 70 years on
By Emily McCrary
April 23, 2025
Foy Information Desk at Auburn University, Photo by Emily McCrary
I
f you sit at the James E. Foy Information Desk in the Melton Student Center at Auburn University, answering the phones on a Wednesday night, you might be responsible for answering a question like this: “If you died on the operating table and they declared you legally dead and wrote out a death certificate and everything, but then you came back to life, what are the legal ramifications? Do you technically no longer exist? Do you have to be declared undead by a judge?”
A little later, the phone will ring again, and the caller might ask, “Who is the most famous person in the world?” Your next question: “How do you get the Super Serum in Call of Duty?” And finally, when you pick up the phone close to eleven o’clock, quitting time, you might hear someone blow a giant raspberry then hang up.
I spent the better part of two days and nights listening to students answer questions at the Foy desk, where phones have been ringing since 1953, when James E. Foy, Auburn’s then dean of students, opened the line as a resource for students and then as a service to the public. For just as long, students who sit there have been answering any question asked of them—or at least tried their best.
By nine o’clock, the student center is quiet. That’s when people like Beulah call.
T
he desk looks different today than it did seventy years ago. For starters, it’s in an expensive
, modern-looking student center. The old Foy Hall still exists, and now houses a few small student-engagement offices; but it’s got low ceilings and could use an update. There used to be stacks of books at the desk—encyclopedias and dictionaries, reference texts, phone books, the
Farmers’ Almanac
, the
Guinness Book of World Records
, and Emily Post’s
Etiquette
—but they’ve been replaced by three desktop iMacs, the really nice ones, whose backs are blue and orange, like the school’s colors. As for the phone number, that’s still the same: (334) 844-4244.
A day’s worth of calls to Foy would look a lot like someone’s browser history: What is cefuroxime prescribed for? What’s the average cost of an acre of land in Texas? What’s the cheapest property in New Jersey? How much is Elon Musk worth? What’s the customer service phone number for Costco? How much is a ticket to the Super Bowl? What is watercress? What is that weird smell? Are AirPods Pro 2 waterproof? What do I do if there’s a snake in my house? What are all the names for female genitals? (Foy student workers won’t respond to that last question, but that doesn’t stop callers from asking it.
)
About
13 million people in the US
and
2.6 billion people globally
don’t use the internet, whether for reasons of availability, desire, cost, or religion. Some may have it but don’t feel confident using it. To their callers, who dial from all over the world, these students are the internet. And lucky for callers, these students are remarkably non-judgmental when it comes to the questions they’re asked.
The employee manual for the Foy desk is ten sheets of 8.5x11, with instructions on how to clock in and out and pick up shifts. Training for the phones is minimal. More or less, the rules are these: Be as polite as possible, end the call if the question is offensive, don’t answer anything that sounds like a homework question, and if someone makes a threat, hang up and dial *57 (that helps the police trace the call), then tell your supervisor.
During the day, the phones ring about ten to fifteen times an hour. Most of the calls are from the general public. Occasionally, an Auburn student calls to ask about basketball tickets or whether their brown jacket ended up in the lost and found. As classes wrap up for the afternoon and the sun sets, the big windows that filter sunlight turn into mirrors. Calls become less frequent, so students working at the desk settle into their homework. It’s a perk of the job. By nine o’clock, the student center is quiet. That’s when people like Beulah call.
Foy student workers have exceptional manners, and they don’t go poking around in someone else’s business.
B
eulah has a lot of pets and an affinity for bearded dragons. She seems to attract wild animals too: There’s been a fox in her yard, a snake in her house, a spider on her curtains. She’s called to ask for the phone number for an exterminator more than once. While most callers are off the line in less than two minutes, Beulah’s calls last at least fifteen. But who she is, the students hardly know. Accents are sometimes a giveaway, but hers isn’t Southern, nor is it apparently from the Northeast, where her area code suggests she lives. Kamran Kimber, an overachieving junior studying business management, loves getting Beulah’s calls. “She sounds like—oh, my goodness—who was the lady who played in
White Lotus
?” He stops to th

data.article_summary: Oberon Pi 是 Richard Gleaves 将 Peter de Wachter 的 Oberon 系统模拟器移植到 Raspberry Pi OS 的版本。Gleaves 是前 UCSD Pascal 项目成员，并撰写了《Modula-2 for Pascal Programmers》一书。Oberon Pi 主要改进了用户界面，简化了新用户的学习曲线，同时保留了 Oberon 系统的核心特性。它还集成了 Andreas Pirklbauer 对 Oberon 编译器的修改，完全实现了 CASE 语句并修复了一些编译器错误。该项目提供了全面的文档和指南，包括新的用户指南和原始 Oberon 文档，并可在 Raspberry Pi 400 上运行。为在 64 位系统上运行，需对设置进行一些调整。所有资源可在 GitHub 上获取。

主要讨论点：关于"Project Oberon 2013"及其相关技术（Raspberry Pi、Oberon系统、其历史与应用）的讨论

不同观点：
• [pdw] 认为该项目只是在一个标准的Raspberry Pi Linux发行版上预装了"Project Oberon 2013"的模拟器。他解释了Oberon系统的历史，指出"Project Oberon 2013"是该系统早期版本的代表，并强调该版本较为原始，后续版本功能更加丰富。

• [lproven] 表示对该项目感兴趣，但更希望看到一个真正的裸机移植版本，提到了以前A2系统对StrongARM裸机的支持，并指出相关工具已经存在。

• [wirrbel] 认为Oberon和Go语言在结构上非常相似，指出Go语言可能受到了Oberon的启发，或者两者是趋同演化的结果，显示了Wirth思想的强大影响力。

• [owlstuffing] 推荐了Luca Boasso的oberonc项目（JVM上的Oberon实现），提供了一个额外的资源链接。

• [skoodge] 提到页面上链接的PDF文件很有价值，重读Wirth的《Plea for Lean Software》后认为其观点依然有效，并询问是否有类似Oberon的仍在活跃开发的项目。

• [rbanffy] 回忆了以前在Apple应用商店上运行的Oberon应用，以及一个AT&T Blit终端模拟器，两者都已消失。

• [xkriva11] 提供了另一个基于Ultibo的裸机Oberon版本的链接。

• [Rochus] 提供了一个相关讨论的链接。

• [teddyh] 提到Raspberry Pi名字的由来，并指出其最初设计目的是直接启动到Python环境。

• [rbanffy] 再次发言，比较了学习使用9front和Oberon的不同体验。

• [anthk] 提到DuskOS正在整合Oberon，提供了一个额外的项目链接。

• [qwerty456127] 质疑Oberon的实用性，指出其功能上的局限性，如Unicode支持有限、图形支持有限、缺乏XML、JSON、HTTP等现代功能。

补充讨论：
• 关于Oberon系统的历史和版本差异是讨论的一个重点，特别是其早期版本的原始性与后续版本的改进。
• 对Oberon在现代应用中的实用性存在争议，有人质疑其功能不足，也有人通过提供资源和项目链接展示其现代应用的可能性。
• 裸机移植和不同操作系统（如9front和Oberon）的比较也是讨论的一个重要方面。
• 最后，关于是否有类似Oberon的仍在活跃开发的项目，以及Oberon在现代计算环境中的位置和价值，也是讨论的一个重要方向。

43885478.article_content:
Oberon, the jewel by Niklaus Wirth and Jürg Gutknecht: Operating System, Compiler and Computer.
Oberon Pi is a port of Peter de Wachter’s Project Oberon emulator to the Raspberry Pi OS by Richard Gleaves.
Richard Gleaves is a former UCSD Pascal Project member, and author of the 1984 Springer book “Modula-2 for Pascal Programmers”.
The software changes were mostly limited to the UI, with the goal of flattening out the learning curve for new users of the Oberon system, not only read about in a few places online, but also experienced firsthand after bringing the system up.
Richard also added
Andreas Pirklbauer
’s changes to the Oberon compiler, to fully implement CASE statements and fix a few compiler bugs.
The main feature in Oberon Pi is its documentation, which includes new user guides Richard wrote for the Oberon operating system and draw application, along with a complete set of Wirth’s original PDF documents on the Oberon language, now made more usable with the addition of TOCs to the PDFs.
Here an uptodate downloadable list of relevant Oberon documents:
Oberon – The Overlooked Jewel, Michael Franz
Compiler Construction, 2017, Niklaus Wirth
Differences between Revised Oberon and Oberon, 2008, Niklaus Wirth
The Programming Language Oberon, 2013/2026
Programming A Tutorial, 1982/2015, Niklaus Wirth
A Plea for Lean Software, Niklaus Wirth
Project Oberon
The Design of an Operating System, a Compiler and a Computer
Revised Edition 2013
Niklaus Wirth, Jurg Gutknecht
Oberon Pi Setup Guide
Oberon Pi Quick Reference
Oberon Pi System User Guide
Oberon Pi Draw Quick Reference
Oberon Pi Draw User Guide
See the github at
https://github.com/richardgleaves/Oberon-Pi
for Oberon Pi, ready to run on the Raspberry Pi OS.
See below how to run Oberon Pi on a 64 bit architecture Raspberry Pi OS.
Oberon Pi
Author
: Richard Gleaves
This version of Oberon, named Oberon Pi, emulates the Oberon system on a Raspberry Pi 400, using the Raspberry Pi OS as the host operating system.
Oberon Pi runs as an application in the Raspberry Pi OS. When you execute the Oberon Pi command, a window opens on the Pi OS desktop. This window is the Oberon *display*, and it works like a separate computer running the Oberon system, with its own windows, command menus, and file system.
Goals
The original Oberon system includes many unusual user interface elements. These elements make the system worthy of study, both as a historical software artifact, and as a case study in user interface design.
But the original system also includes a few non-key features (such as *mouse interclicking* and opaque command names) which make the system difficult to learn.
The primary goal and purpose of Oberon Pi is instructional: to make the original Oberon system more accessible, by updating the non-key user interface elements to contemporary software standards, while preserving the key elements that make Oberon unique.
Oberon Pi includes source code and full documentation of the Oberon system and language. The system user guide is provided as both a standalone PDF file and as integrated help in the Oberon system.
System Requirements
–  Raspberry Pi computer (Pi4 or Pi 5 preferred)
–  32 bit or 64 bit Raspberry Pi OS desktop vrsion(Bookworm or Bullseye)
–  Desktop computer monitor (large preferred)
Installation
For details see the *Oberon Pi Setup Guide*.
History
The Oberon system was originally developed in the late 1980s by Niklaus Wirth and Jürg Gutknecht. In 2013 the system was re-implemented by Wirth and Paul Reed to run on a custom RISC processor. In 2014 an emulator for the RISC processor was developed by Peter De Wachter. Oberon Pi is a port of the emulator to the Raspberry Pi OS.
Install and run on 64 bit Raspberry Pi OS
The github distribution is for the 32 bit Raspberry Pi OS.
Make these changes to run Oberon Pi on a 64 bit Raspberry Pi OS after the initial setup but before launching Oberon Pi:
cd Oberon\Emulator
mv risc risc.pi400
sudo apt install libsdl2-dev
make
which will produce (silently) a new ‘risc’ executable and follow the ‘Oberon Pi Setup Guide’.
Here an archive with both 32 bit and 64 bit ‘risc’ executables.

data.title: Show HN: I taught AI to commentate Pong in real time
data.author: pncnmnp
data.article_summary: "xPong" 是一个经典游戏 Pong 的变种，集成了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的实时解说功能。该项目利用 OpenAI 的 gpt-4o-mini-tts 技术，实现了近实时的游戏解说。游戏包含一个模拟15年赛事的锦标赛，每年有四场大型赛事，通过 Elo 等级分模拟玩家和比赛。在第16年，全球排名前两位的玩家将在世界锦标赛决赛中对决。游戏中的解说分为开场、逐球解说和闭幕解说三层，由两名评论员交替发言。解说逻辑基于事件驱动，重要事件会打断解说，之后再继续。游戏还通过最近邻搜索对比历史数据提供深度分析。项目使用 MIT 许可证，音效来自 SoundReality 和 OpenAI 的资源。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成评论在Pong游戏中的应用及其潜在扩展

不同观点：
• [mtlynch] 认为Pong游戏过于简单，AI评论缺乏挑战性，预编程即可实现。并质疑该技术能否应用于更复杂的游戏如象棋或德州扑克，以增加评论的深度和趣味性。
• [blakeburch] 支持该想法，并建议将其应用于如《英雄联盟》或《火箭联盟》等电竞项目，认为这可以提升观赛体验。
• [indigodaddy] 提出替代评论的想法，特别是对“对视竞赛”这样的活动，建议使用幽默、干涩的评论风格。
• [QRe] 指出由于脚本生成和文本转语音（TTS）的延迟，评论可能跟不上快节奏游戏的步伐，特别是在体育类游戏中。
• [croemer] 分享了视频中更精彩的部分，以跳过无聊的赛前谈话，认为这样能提升体验。
• [petercooper] 希望在工作时也能有类似的评论，特别是对自己编程工作的幽默调侃，认为这可以增加趣味性。
• [jart] 提到主流游戏如John Madden是否已有类似功能，认为这是LLM（大语言模型）的良好应用场景。
• [neilv] 质疑生成评论的真实性，担心评论内容是否会纯属虚构。
• [hvardhan878] 建议模仿著名解说员Peter Drury的语调和情感，甚至让Pong游戏变得情感化。
• [smus] 认为该项目本质上只是API调用的组合，算不上真正的“教学”AI。
• [sim7c00] 觉得视频开头较枯燥，但游戏开始后非常有趣，体验令人兴奋。
• [danjl] 对圆形球体提出疑问，可能对游戏画面或物理效果有不同看法。
• [ayongpm] 认为AI评论能增加Pong游戏的趣味性，并建议举办职业Pong比赛以提升游戏的地位。
• [isaacremuant] 肯定了该想法的趣味性，但认为评论内容缺乏深度，建议增加更多的实时解说，减少无关填充内容，并提出通过外部事件接收和生成评论以减少延迟。

补充讨论：
- 评论延迟和如何减少延迟是多个评论者关注的焦点，尤其是对于快节奏游戏。
- 不同游戏的复杂性和适用性被广泛讨论，特别是象棋、德州扑克和电竞项目。
- 评论的真实性和深度受到质疑，部分评论者担心生成内容可能失实或缺乏相关性。

xPong
As the name suggests,
xPong
is all about Pong — but with a twist: there’s LLM-based commentary generation integrated into the game.
I’ve wanted to do this for the longest time — in fact, back in my undergrad days,
I used to carry around a GitHub Gist to store such ideas, and an entry for this one dates back to Feb 16 2020.
That’s five years!
Anyway, for the longest time we never had the right technology to pull this off in a cost-effective, near-realtime manner.
However, late last month, with
OpenAI’s
gpt-4o-mini-tts
, we finally have the resources to do it!
I envision a future where
gpt-4o-mini-tts
-like software is integrated on the edge.
When that happens, next-generation gaming consoles will leverage such technology, opening up a whole universe of possibilities in gaming, especially in sports-simulation titles.
Hope you have a blast tinkering with this game and its source code!
Demo
Installation
Before installing the dependencies, I encourage you to
create and activate a virtual environment
- for example, run
python3 -m venv .venv
and then
source .venv/bin/activate
on macos/linux.
To install the Python dependencies, use:
pip3 install -r requirements.txt
Next, create an API key in OpenAI’s dashboard.
For this, follow the steps in OpenAI’s
Create and export an API key
docs.
Once you have the key, store it in a
.env
file at the root of this repository:
OPENAI_API_KEY
=
your-api-key
Because this code leverages an Electron-like library
Eel
, you will also need a
Chromium-based browser
.
When everything is set up, run:
python3 main.py
Add
--cache
to cache LLM-generated player metadata for later runs, and
--no-opening
to skip the opening commentary.
What’s in it?
It’s packed with ideas!
There’s a tournament simulator that simulates 15 years' worth of tournaments. Each year includes four majors — sixty events in all. Players and matches are simulated using
Elo
.
In the
16th year
, when the main match starts, the world’s top two players face off in the World Championship Final.
Two AIs are playing against each other in a game of Pong, with variations in their reaction times and shot speeds.
The commentary logic has
three layers
- opening commentary with a scorecard, in-game ball-by-ball commentary, and closing commentary.
Two commentators take turns talking to each other and the audience.
Commentary is interrupted when an important in-game event occurs, then resumes from where it left off afterward.
In-game commentary is driven by an
event-based pipeline
: actions are logged as events, periodically parsed into metrics,
those metrics are ranked by priority to decide which deserve mention next, and the resulting text is fed through TTS.
With 15 years of historical data, the game uses
nearest-neighbor search
to find similar past games and share insights.
It even goofs around - comparing the current playing style to past legends and sprinkling in a few locker-room whispers.
License and acknowledgements
This code is licensed under the
MIT License
.
The paddle-hitting sound was generated using SoundReality's
"Tennis Ball Hit"
sound.
It is licensed under Pixabay's
"Content License"
.
The filler sounds were generated with
https://www.openai.fm/
and abide by OpenAI's
terms and policies
.

data.title: A visual feast of galaxies, from infrared to X-ray
data.author: giuliomagnifico
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了NASA/ESA/CSA詹姆斯·韦伯空间望远镜拍摄的一组壮观的星系图像，结合了红外和X射线数据。左侧图像显示了大量星系，其中一些距离我们数十亿光年；右侧图像则展示了炽热气体发出的X射线（蓝色光晕）。这些星系属于COSMOS-Web项目的研究范围，该项目旨在探索宇宙中大规模结构的形成，尤其是星系群如何演化和连接成星系团。韦伯望远镜的红外能力使得探测可以追溯到宇宙仅19亿年时的星系群。图像展示了不同形状、颜色和距离的星系，反映了它们的多样性和演化历史。COSMOS-Web计划还旨在研究宇宙再电离时期以及星系与其外围晕的关系演变。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对宇宙和光波的感知与解释

不同观点：
• [HocusLocus的观点] 认为宇宙是一个 vibrating universe，其中存在超越常规感知的联系，如颜色和声音的交织。HocusLocus 描述了一种理想状态，即通过感知超声波、紫外线、红外线和X射线等不可见光波，人类可以体验到更广泛的美丽。他引用了"OM"这个词，似乎是在强调一种宇宙的整体和谐与统一，表达了一种超越物理感知的灵性理解。

• [PaulHoule的观点] 则从科学角度解释了宇宙中的光波现象，特别是红外线的感知。PaulHoule 提到了将红外强度转换为可见颜色 (r,g,b) 的技术方法，并引用了天文学资料来解释遥远星系为何看起来更红，这是因为气体加热到极高温度所致。这表明 PaulHoule 更关注于从物理学和天文学角度理解宇宙现象，强调了科学解释而非灵性或感知体验。

补充讨论：
• HocusLocus 的评论带有一种诗意和哲学意味，试图通过感官之间的交错来描述宇宙的复杂性，并且强调了人类感知的局限性以及通过灵性词汇（如"OM"）理解宇宙的可能性。
  
• PaulHoule 的评论则带有明显的科学分析色彩，引用了具体的天文学资料，讨论了星系颜色变化的物理原因，关注于如何通过技术手段将不可见光波转化为人类可以理解的视觉信息。

• 争议的焦点在于如何理解和解释宇宙现象：是通过科学实证的方式，还是通过感知和灵性体验的方式。这反映了科学与灵性在理解宇宙本质上的不同路径。

On the
left
, the new
Picture of the Month
from the NASA/ESA/CSA
James Webb Space Telescope
features an astounding number of galaxies. On the right, as a blue glow, we see also the X-ray light coming from the blazing hot gas that fills the space between the galaxies.
The objects in this frame span an incredible range of distances, from stars within our own Milky Way, marked by diffraction spikes, to galaxies billions of light-years away. The focus of this image is a group of galaxies, the largest concentration of which can be found just below the centre of this image. These galaxies glow with white-gold light. We see this galaxy group as it appeared when the Universe was 6.5 billion years old, a little less than half the Universe’s current age.
The galaxy group pictured here is the most massive group in what’s called the COSMOS-Web field. COSMOS stands for Cosmic Evolution Survey. This survey has enlisted several telescopes, including Webb, the NASA/ESA
Hubble Space Telescope
, and ESA’s
XMM-Newton
space observatory to gaze deeply at a single patch of sky.
COSMOS-Web aims to understand how massive structures like galaxy clusters came to be. More than half of the galaxies in our Universe belong to galaxy groups like the one pictured here. Studying galaxy groups is critical for understanding how individual galaxies link up to form galaxy clusters, the largest gravitationally bound structures in the Universe. Belonging to a galaxy group can also alter the course of a galaxy’s evolution through mergers and gravitational interactions.
Webb’s infrared capabilities and sensitive instruments have pushed the search for galaxy groups farther back into cosmic history, revealing galaxy groups as far back as when the Universe was only 1.9 billion years old – just 14% of its current age.
The image on the left combines infrared data from Webb’s
Near-InfraRed Camera
(NIRCam) instrument with further infrared observations from Hubble. On the right, the X-ray data, shown in purple, highlights the presence of hot gas concentrated within the
X-ray galaxy group
. These X-ray data come from XMM-Newton, with contributions from NASA’s Chandra X-ray Observatory.
This image presents a visual feast of galaxies. Take a moment to examine the galactic buffet: you’ll see galaxies with delicate spiral arms or warped disks, galaxies with smooth, featureless faces, and even galaxies that are interacting or merging and have taken on an array of strange shapes.
The range of colours is also fascinating, representing both galaxies with different ages of stars – younger stars appear bluer, and older stars appear redder – as well as galaxies at different distances. The more distant a galaxy, the redder it appears.
COSMOS-Web is a 255-hour Webb Treasury programme that maps 0.54 square degrees (a little more than two-and-a-half times the area covered by three full moons) of the COSMOS field using four NIRCam filters. Treasury programmes have the potential to answer multiple important questions about our Universe.
COSMOS-Web has three key goals: to identify galaxies during
the epoch of reionisation
, when the first stars and galaxies reionised the Universe’s hydrogen gas; to probe the formation of the Universe’s most massive galaxies; and to understand how the relationship between the mass of a galaxy’s stars and the mass of its extended galactic halo evolves over the course of cosmic history.

Image Description:
An area of deep space with thousands of galaxies in various shapes and sizes on a black background. A few gold-coloured galaxies are bunched closely together in the centre. A large, translucent purple cloud lies over the galaxies, thickest across the centre where the gold galaxies sit, and fainter up to the right. This shows where X-rays are emitted by hot gas in the group of galaxies.]

data.title: Evidence of controversial Planet 9 uncovered in sky surveys taken 23 years apart
data.author: spchampion2
data.article_summary:
文章主要讨论了假设中的太阳系行星——第九行星（Planet Nine），该行星最早于2014年被提出，但尚未被正式探测到。天文学家通过一些跨海王星天体（TNOs）的轨道扰动推测其存在。第九行星估计半径是地球的2到4倍，质量约为地球的十倍。2016年，加州理工学院的Michael Brown和Konstantin Batygin提出这一假设，以解释柯伊伯带天体轨道异常聚集的现象。

最近，台湾国立清华大学的天文学家Terry Long Phan团队分析了两次相隔23年的深空红外线观测数据，发现了一个可能的候选对象。该团队使用了1983年IRAS卫星和2006年JAXA的AKARI卫星的数据，通过排除视差效应和快速移动天体，找到了一颗可能的距离太阳约700天文单位的行星。然而，这一发现仍需进一步验证。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：围绕假设的第九行星（Planet 9）的各种观点和讨论，包括其距离描述、性质猜测、语法问题以及天文学分类争议。

不同观点：
• 一些评论者关注如何更好地描述假设行星的距离。AIPedant认为用“比冥王星远15倍”比“比地球远700倍”更易于理解，因为这样更能传达出行星距离之远。
• randomtoast提出一个有趣的理论，认为第九行星可能是一个原始黑洞，大小类似于高尔夫球，这可以解释为什么我们只能看到引力效应而无法直接观察到该天体。
• alex_duf对用词提出疑问，认为“farther”应该用于表示实际距离，而“further”则用于比喻意义，反映出对英语用词的困惑。

补充讨论：
• perihelions指出，某些假设和观测结果与Batygin和Brown提出的第九行星假设不符，特别是关于轨道倾角的差异，这引发了对假设天体性质的争议。
• K0balt表达了对原始黑洞理论的偏好，认为这将非常有趣且具有科学价值。
• ashoeafoot将假设行星的轨道比作“巨大的吉他弦”，质疑其受其他天体引力影响的可能性。
• rootsudo对“行星X”变成“行星9”的命名演变感到困惑，这牵涉到冥王星行星地位的变化。
• bikenaga提供了一篇原始论文的链接，试图将讨论引向更科学的依据。
• gitroom调侃了整个讨论的“书呆子”性质，并质疑行星定义的稳定性。
• vpribish对不同天文图像的质量和准确性提出质疑，指出在不同图像中观测结果的不一致。
• _heimdall表达了对冥王星降级的不满，坚持认为冥王星应被视为第九行星。
• anthk和astar1的评论带有幽默和调侃性质，分别提到编程社区和科幻元素（如“质量效应”游戏中的Mass Relay）。
• interludead和tiahura则反思了天文学术语和命名的演变，以及我们对自己太阳系的了解程度。

争议焦点：
• 主要争议在于假设的第九行星距离和性质的描述，以及天文学命名和分类的一致性问题。

43874641.article_content:
Planet Nine is a hypothesized massive planet, first proposed in 2014, that is speculated to orbit far out in the solar system. It has not been detected formally. Instead, astronomers have inferred its presence from perceived perturbations of the orbits of some Trans-Neptunian Objects (TNOs). The planet is estimated to be 2 to 4 times the radius, and about ten times the mass of the Earth.
(Image credit: Mark Garlick/Science Photo Library/Getty Images)
The best candidate yet for the elusive Planet Nine has been spotted in two deep infrared surveys taken 23 years apart. If this mystery object really is Planet Nine, it would have a mass greater than Neptune, and currently be about 700 times farther from the sun than Earth is.
The possibility of additional planets in our
solar system
has been proposed many times, going under names such as "Planet X," because experts thought the concept of an extra planet in our vicinity of the cosmos could explain a perceived regularity in mass extinctions on Earth. Perhaps, they said, the periodic influx of
comets
that impact Earth are pushed our way by an unseen planet. However, the supposed periodicity in mass extinctions has not held up to scrutiny, and so the need for that particular Planet X has gone away. This brings us to Planet Nine.
Planet Nine
is unrelated to the Planet X concept, and rather put forward in 2016 by Michael Brown and Konstantin Batygin of the California Institute of Technology to explain an unusual bunching of orbits of some objects in the
Kuiper Belt
, such as Sedna. This proposed Planet Nine would be more massive than
Earth
, and orbit on a highly eccentric path that takes it hundreds of
astronomical units
from the
sun
(one astronomical unit is the distance between Earth and the sun). That far away, it would be extremely difficult to detect.
However, the expectation is that Planet Nine would appear brighter in mid- and far-infrared light than it would in visible light.

Giant planet or 'failed star?' Newfound mystery world blurs the lines
Scientists discover super-Earth exoplanets are more common in the universe than we thought
Vast swarms of hidden galaxies may be secretly bathing the universe in a soft glow
Now, a team led by astronomer Terry Long Phan of the National Tsing Hua University in Taiwan has delved into the archives of two far-infrared all-sky surveys in search of Planet Nine — and incredibly, they have found something that could possibly be Planet Nine.
The Infrared Astronomy Satellite, IRAS, launched in 1983 and surveyed the
universe
for almost a year before being decommissioned. Then, in 2006, the Japanese Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) launched AKARI, another infrared astronomy satellite that was active between 2006 and 2011.
Phan's team were looking for objects that appeared in IRAS's database, then appeared to have moved by the time AKARI took a look. The amount of movement on the sky would be tiny — about three arcminutes per year at a distance of approximately 700 astronomical units (AU). One arcminute is 1/60 of an angular degree.

But there's an extra motion that Phan's team had to account for. As the Earth orbits the sun, our view of the position of very distant objects changes slightly in an effect called
parallax
. It is the same phenomenon as when you hold your index finger up to your face, close one eye and look at your finger, and then switch eyes — your finger appears to move as a result of you looking at it from a slightly different position.
Planet Nine would appear to move on the sky because of parallax as Earth moves around the sun. On any particular day, it might seem to be in one position, then six months later when Earth is on the other side of the sun, it would shift to another position, perhaps by 10 to 15 arcminutes — then, six months after that, it would seem to shift back to its original position. To remove the effects of parallax, Phan's team searched for Planet Nine on the same date every year in the AKARI data, because on any given date it would appear in the same place, with zero parallax shift, every year.
They then also scrutinized each candidate object that their search threw up on an hourly basis. If a candidate is a fast-moving, nearby object, then its motion would be detectable from hour to hour, and could therefore be ruled out.
This careful search led Phan's team to a single object, a tiny dot in the infrared data.
A comparison of the position of the candidate object in the IRAS data (left) and the AKARI data (right) and the distance in arcminutes between them.
(Image credit: Phan et al (2025))

data.title: The Strategic Oil Bombing Campaign
data.author: Michelangelo11
data.article_summary: 本文主要讨论二战期间盟军对德国的"战略石油战役"的效果，而非其道德争议。战役始于1944年3月，高峰期在同年11月，目标是打击德国的石油产业。策划轰炸行动时，需确定具体目标，包括电力、食品、燃料、交通、科研中心等。全面摧毁所有目标不切实际，需根据影响速度、战后占领考量和国内政治支持等因素进行优先排序。尽管电力设施数量庞大且难以摧毁，食品生产亦难通过轰炸消灭，但石油产业因其集中性和对战争机器的关键作用成为理想目标。仅需摧毁约20个设施，甚至6个关键工厂，即可瘫痪德军的燃料供应，尤其是高性能航空燃料。盟军对德国的石油产业结构有相当了解，得益于战前英美在德国工业建设中的参与。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：二战期间美国空军对德国地下燃料储存设施的轰炸行动及其优先级问题

不同观点：
• [schroeding] 认为美国空军在1945年4月对德国燃料储存设施的轰炸效果参差不齐，并质疑为何该目标没有被更早列为高优先级。他指出，燃料设施主要用于为德国空军混合燃料，且该设施在长时间内没有被有效攻击，尽管其地理位置和特征明显，且靠近铁路和空军基地。他质疑盟军为何在轰炸行动中迟迟未将其作为主要目标。

© Calum E. Douglas, 27th July 2021.
The bombing of Germany continues to elicit a great deal of controversy. The views range from “All is fair in love and war, what did Germany expect?” through to: “The Allies lost the moral high-ground by intentionally obliterating civilian areas, the means are as important as the end”. This website will not explore the moral component, but will instead look at exploring the sucess of what has become known as “The Strategic Oil Campaign”, which began in approximately March 1944 (the official date is May, but serious attacks were already in progress) and peaked in November 1944 (although it carried on until the very end of the war). That said, the Oil Campaign certainly resulted in dramatic reduction in civilian casualties relative to attacks on targets in, or on the periphery of cities like Dresden.
The first question for the planners of any bombing offensive, is to decide what the goal of it should be. Obviously the overall goal is to end the war, but to do so, the bombers must still be given a specific set of targets. There are of course a large set of targets which one might propose.
Electricity generation
Food
Fuel, lubricating oils and fuel-oils (for ships)
Political & decision making hotspots (Parliaments, command centres etc*)
Mechanical manufacturing facilities
Mining
Transportation
Chemical industries
Academic and Industrial Research centres
Military testing facilities
Direct attacks on the armed forces (airfields, harbors, ships, tanks, soldiers barracks)
*  There is evidence that most of the major players (usually) shied away from wiping out or assassinating enemy high command personalities, despite the obvious attractions of doing so. Probably they rightly worried that if the attack was not 100% successful on the first try, that reprisals might be made, in which case it would be their necks on the line. During interrogation by General Carl Spaatz, Göring responded to the question on why Allied commands (such as Eisenhower`s in Africa at one point) were not directly attacked, he responded to Spaatz “We did not like to attack headquarters anyway. We thought that might be a mutual understanding.” See:
Interrogation of Reich Marshall Hermann Göring (pg 15)
RITTER SCHULE, AUGSBURG
1700 to 1900 Hours
10 May 1945
This lengthy list is far from exhaustive, and with a conventionally armed military, removing all of these targets is clearly impossible. So some form of prioritising is required. Factors important in forming such a list include:
Duration, how quickly do we need the impact to be observed in the enemy`s operations ?
Post war considerations, after it ends, we may have to occupy the country until a stable (friendly) system of government is installed. If we wipe out means of food production by poisoning the water and the earth, this will make occupation very difficult and even more expensive.
What are the acceptable losses before home political support diminishes ?
Electricity would seem an obvious choice, however, there were a phenomenal number of plants involved in electricity generation in wartime Germany (around a hundred major facilities). So this is in fact, very difficult to wipe out. Food cannot be wiped out economically, but supporting industries like the fertiliser plants (which rely principally on Nitrogen) can be. Manufacturing plants are surprisingly difficult to eliminate, even plants which “appear” to be destroyed may in fact have machines which are in most cases still workable, which can simply be distributed or even moved underground. Transportation is hard to eliminate without complete air superiority, which facilitates low level operations against trails and roads. Research and testing centres can be wiped out, but the effect of this may not have any noticeable impact on the enemies operations for years, and direct attacks on the military can merely be replaced if the enemy still has energy, materials and factories.
[Please open the images below in a new window or download them or the detail is impossible to see]
Map of German fuel refineries, showing how few sites there were, and how they were all clustered together, by necessity of being near coal reserves.
In the end, the lynchpin proved to be the petrochemical industry. It is at the very centre of the “web” of industry and warfare. Thus instead of having to wipe out nearly a hundred electrical stations (which would have resulted in such a dilution of bombing, that they would have been repaired reasonably quickly, for the most part) – the oil industry could be eliminated by wiping out around twenty facilities, and in fact, even just six would be enough to stop the Luftwaffe, as only a very few plants made high performance fuels for aircraft.
The Allies knew rather a lot about most of the German manufacturing facilities, as, somewhat awkwardly, both British and American engineers, chemists and firms had played a significant role in both information exchange, and indeed construction of German fu
43885284.article_summary: 本文主要讨论二战期间盟军对德国的"战略石油战役"的效果，而非其道德争议。战役始于1944年3月，高峰期在同年11月，目标是打击德国的石油产业。策划轰炸行动时，需确定具体目标，包括电力、食品、燃料、交通、科研中心等。全面摧毁所有目标不切实际，需根据影响速度、战后占领考量和国内政治支持等因素进行优先排序。尽管电力设施数量庞大且难以摧毁，食品生产亦难通过轰炸消灭，但石油产业因其集中性和对战争机器的关键作用成为理想目标。仅需摧毁约20个设施，甚至6个关键工厂，即可瘫痪德军的燃料供应，尤其是高性能航空燃料。盟军对德国的石油产业结构有相当了解，得益于战前英美在德国工业建设中的参与。

主要讨论点：关于LSD和MDMA等药物的使用、风险及社会认知的讨论

不同观点：
• **关于LSD相关读物的推荐**：
   - [edweis] 推荐了《The Rose Of Paracelsus》一书，认为这本书对LSD历史和制造进行了诗意且引人入胜的描述，尽管阅读难度较大，但仍值得一读。
   
• **MDMA的娱乐使用与责任**：
   - [ativzzz] 认为MDMA是一种有趣的药物，愿意在未来生活中每年使用一次。然而，他指出许多人不能负责任地使用药物，要么完全戒断，要么沉迷其中。他表达了对找到负责任的药物使用者的困难感，特别是处于30多岁的年纪。
   
• **MDMA的安全问题与性侵风险**：
   - [hristov] 分享了个人经历，指出MDMA（或称Ecstasy）如今被用作迷奸药物。他描述了三次被下药的经历，尽管没有导致性侵，但强调了这种行为的犯罪性质。他还提到，MDMA常被错误地认为是一种“充满爱”的药物，这种误解可能被潜在的犯罪分子利用。他呼吁对药物引发的症状保持警觉，并在必要时采取法律行动。

补充讨论：
• **MDMA的历史与死亡案例**：
   - [hristov] 提到MDMA在90年代和2000年代初的狂欢派对中导致了一些死亡事件，尽管有人声称这些死亡是由其他原因引起的，但具体原因尚不明确。
   
• **对MDMA的浪漫化认知的批判**：
   - [hristov] 批判了将MDMA视为无害、充满爱的药物的观点，认为这种浪漫化认知可能被用作性侵的借口，强调了这种行为的犯罪性质和严重性。
   
争议焦点：
• **MDMA的娱乐使用与安全问题**：
   - 一方面，[ativzzz] 支持负责任的MDMA使用，但表达了找到合适使用者的困难。
   - 另一方面，[hristov] 强调MDMA作为迷奸药物的危险性，呼吁警惕并采取法律行动。

总结：评论中既有对药物使用文化的推荐和个人娱乐支持，也有对药物潜在风险，尤其是MDMA被用于犯罪行为的严重警告。讨论中涉及了药物使用的责任问题以及社会认知的复杂性。

data.title: In kids, EEG monitoring of consciousness safely reduces anesthetic use
data.author: LorenDB
data.article_summary: 一项在日本进行的随机对照临床试验显示，使用脑电图（EEG）监测意识状态可以帮助麻醉师安全减少小儿手术中七氟烷的使用量。在1至6岁的170多名儿童中，通过EEG引导麻醉剂量，患者在术后恢复更快，谵妄发生率更低。具体而言，EEG组儿童所需的七氟烷诱导浓度从标准的5%降至2%，维持浓度从2.5%降至0.9%。此外，EEG组儿童的拔管时间、苏醒时间和出院时间分别平均提前3.3分钟、21.4分钟和16.5分钟，且医疗费用和环境影响均有所减少。研究结果发表在《JAMA Pediatrics》上，表明EEG监测能在保证麻醉效果的同时减少麻醉剂用量，改善术后恢复。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：小儿麻醉中使用不同麻醉药物和监测方法的有效性和合理性

不同观点：
• [kilimounjaro] 认为在小儿麻醉中，使用异丙酚（propofol）和瑞米芬太（remifent）比七氟醚（sevoflurane）能减少苏醒期谵妄，并且在使用肌肉松弛剂的患者中通过EEG类监测是标准操作。他对研究中低七氟醚组患者在手术刺激下没有移动或咳嗽的原因表示质疑，怀疑可能是因为使用了大量阿片类药物或肌肉松弛剂。

• [crazygringo] 对为何讨论集中在儿童而不是成人表示不解，并询问目前是否对成人使用EEG监测。他质疑为何对儿童的监测比成人更早开始，认为文章缺乏背景信息。

• [Gravityloss] 根据自己多年前的工作经验，指出使用肌肉松弛剂时需要独立的方法直接测量意识。他提到EEG监测在多年前已经相对简单，并表示对这项技术尚未成为主流感到惊讶。

• [Etheryte] 认为如果报道准确，这项研究是好消息，因为尽管全身麻醉有许多优点，但它仍然对患者有危险，尤其是对年轻患者。

• [HocusLocus] 质疑一种观点，即如果孩子被轻微麻醉，他们不会记住手术的痛苦。他担心这种观点可能导致对孩子疼痛处理不当，并提到过去曾有不使用麻醉进行手术的黑暗历史，直到1987年才结束。

• [holowoodman] 提到过去认为小孩子不需要麻醉，因为不会记得疼痛，并担心“药物有害”的普遍趋势可能让人类回到那些黑暗时代。

• [siavosh] 询问这项研究是否与整合信息理论（IIT）有关。

• [Nezghul] 关心麻醉期间的无意识水平，是类似于睡眠的无意识还是“神经元基本不活动”的水平，并提到对麻醉过程中是否“杀死”和“创造”新个体的悖论性思考。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是为何讨论集中在儿童而不是成人，以及EEG监测在儿童中的应用比成人更早开始的原因。
• 另一个争议点是对小儿麻醉中使用不同麻醉药物的效果和合理性的质疑，特别是低七氟醚组患者在手术刺激下没有移动或咳嗽的原因。
• 历史背景和“药物有害”趋势的讨论也引发了对麻醉处理不当的担忧，特别是对儿童患者的影响。
